## Checklist

- [ ] One change per pull request, with no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behaviour, and the checks in CONTRIBUTING.md pass.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or private hostnames in code, tests, logs or screenshots.
- [ ] Any third-party code or data is listed in `REUSE.toml` and `NOTICE`, with its licence in `LICENSES/`.
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour or configuration changed.
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](https://github.com/CodeWithJuber/hikmah-workspace/blob/main/CLA.md) (the CLA bot will ask on your first pull request).
